phases.goal: Practical GLB analysis and conservative part correspondence
candidates: Expand the 512-triangle research limit gradually with explicit computational budgets
Partition large meshes, reuse BVHs and cache bounded calculations
Suggest matches using dimensions, position, centroid and surface features
Represent competing or ambiguous part candidates explicitly
Measure detection limits for holes, thin walls, joints and internal cavities
Prioritize regions with large observed differences
phases.acceptance: Evaluate accuracy and resources on authored synthetic models and explicitly permitted real models; test reordered parts and different triangulations without unnecessary false positives. Sample agreement is not exact geometry.

candidates: Declarative panels, buttons, properties and operators
Compose only permitted parts and validate dependency/API compatibility
Verify operator mode, selection and Undo requirements
Automatically register, enable and function-test generated previews
Support multiple recipes and prepare Blender Extensions formatting
phases.acceptance: Generate multi-feature addons and verify registration, operation and disabling on supported Blender versions. Do not adopt unapproved parts or redistribute license-unreviewed code.

phases.goal: Safe repair and improvement candidate experiments
candidates: Strengthen diagnostic-to-setting/code hypotheses
Generate narrowly scoped change candidates with diffs and restoration
Regenerate and compare only in permitted validation environments
Classify improvement, regression and uncertainty across candidates
Protect previously good parts and record reasons, metrics and decisions
phases.acceptance: Validate detection, proposed changes, regeneration and comparison on CBDK-managed safe sample addons. Applying changes to real user addons requires separate explicit permission/review; no arbitrary code execution, automatic adoption or merge.

phases.goal: Integrated Blender UI and practical delivery
candidates: Blender development panel and part/recipe/test visualization
Side-by-side GLB review and navigation to observed differences
Candidate confirmation and approval interface
Interrupt, failure display and explicit rerun assistance
Real Windows GUI and Undo/Redo verification
Packaging, usage documentation and compatibility checks
phases.acceptance: Operate feature selection, addon generation, testing, shape comparison and candidate review consistently from Blender. Formal distribution requires license, safety and user approvals.

shared_principles: Preserve compatibility and measure quality, safety and performance
Never change original sources or private projects without permission
Keep private GLBs, source and personal data out of public GitHub/Notion
Separate synthetic success, sampled similarity, causal hypotheses and verified effects
Use relevant tests during work and necessary milestone CI
Keep GitHub canonical and Notion as an actual-status mirror
Do not claim fully autonomous creation or repair of arbitrary addons
